title: My bookings
lede: Everything you've requested, where each one stands, and what's left to do.
emptyBody: Once you book a service, it'll show up here with the date, the status, and what's left to do.
notFoundBody: It doesn't exist, or it belongs to someone else.
moneyNote: This is the price the provider listed. Ntizo adds nothing on top.
cancelDialogBody: The {{date}} slot at {{time}} will free up, and {{provider}} will be notified. There's nothing to refund, since you haven't paid yet. If you change your mind, you'll need to submit a new request.
cancelDialogMoved: This booking has already moved on and can no longer be cancelled.
payDialogWaitingBody: We sent an M-Pesa request to {{phone}}. Enter your PIN to authorize {{amount}}.
payDialogWaitingNote: This page updates itself as soon as the payment lands. You can close it safely.
payDialogPhoneBody: That's where we'll send the payment request. It's saved to your profile for next time.
payDialogPhoneHint: It needs to be an active M-Pesa number with enough balance for {{amount}}.
payDialogWindowClosed: The payment window has closed. If you still want this service, you'll need to submit a new request.
payDialogAttemptsSpent: We've tried charging this booking three times without success. Contact support if you need help.
payDialogError: We couldn't request payment right now. Try again in a moment.

section.noteBlurb: What you wrote when you made the request.
